competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages: real broker names, OREA license numbers, transparent-PNG headshots, and direct phone/email, with zero invented track-record or review claims.
note: Wave 3 site-v2 rebuild; broker-data fix 2026-06-02. Large BrokerProfileRow profiles render ONLY verified getBrokers() data — real bio, specialty pills, OREA license #, transparent headshot, and direct phone/email — for all three brokers. This was the fix for getBrokers querying non-existent columns (full_name/phone_direct/headshot_png) and silently serving a thin fallback that hid the real bios + contact + specialties. Still NO fabricated stats, rankings, track-record, or review text. Reviews-platform links render only when google_review_url/zillow_review_url are set in the DB (currently null). Each profile links to the broker's full page via teamPath(slug).

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: hero — 'Three brokers. That's it.' + lede (three licensed brokers, no hand-offs) + canonical Old Mill photo

requiredComponents.name: BrokerProfileRow
requiredComponents.section: team profiles — large headshot + role + name + license + specialty pills + bio + direct contact for all brokers via getBrokers(), each linking to teamPath(slug)

requiredComponents.name: CTABar
requiredComponents.section: 'Ready to talk' — navy CTA band with schedule-a-call + phone
